method.unit: normalized Unicode characters, preserving letters/numbers/combining marks
method.within_trace: mean repeated-window fraction over later length-eligible same-role turns
method.question: mean over available eligible original trials
method.aggregate: common five-setting questions; equal questions within source, equal represented-source weights
method.ci: 20000 source-study cluster percentile draws, conditional on saved trials
method.interpretation: verbatim cross-turn reuse; not judged semantic redundancy or mode collapse
method.normalization: NFKC, casefold, strip fenced code and blockquote lines, remove punctuation/whitespace
